alignment.delay_sign_convention: positive means PA output lags PA input; crop input[:-d], output[d:]
alignment.fractional_delay: diagnostic only; no fractional resampling was applied

feedback_path_precondition: input/output CSVs are assumed already corrected for DC offset, IQ imbalance and feedback frequency response; this pipeline does not estimate those corrections

knots.endpoint_policy: clamp complex correction C outside knot range

normalization.calibration_observation: aligned measured PA output / target gain
normalization.input_full_scale: not frozen here; fixed-point export must explicitly choose and record it
